mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of exterior coating over regular paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior coatings offer several advantages over regular paint, primarily in durability and performance. They provide superior protection against moisture intrusion, preventing stucco damage, rot, and mold growth. Their thicker, more flexible composition resists cracking, chipping, and peeling, which are common issues with standard paint. Additionally, exterior coatings often boast enhanced UV resistance, maintaining color vibrancy longer, and can improve insulation properties, leading to potential energy savings. Their extended lifespan means less frequent maintenance and repainting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior coatings offer superior durability, moisture protection, crack resistance, UV stability, and longer lifespan compared to regular paint, reducing maintenance and potentially improving insulation.
